map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Henry and Morrow publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-29 03:00): mail returned 12,402 (state 11,850); early in person 32,758 (state 29,278); ballots sent 16,968 (state 16,791). Clermont (as of 2026-10-28 23:26): mail returned 10,728 (state 10,246); early in person 14,756 (state 13,535). Crawford (as of 2026-10-28 15:10): mail returned 1,715 (state 1,662); early in person 2,808 (state 2,655). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-28 19:39): mail returned 90,567 (state 85,329); early in person 39,825 (state 35,993). Franklin (as of 2026-10-28 00:15): mail returned 60,847 (state 57,140); early in person 66,899 (state 64,792); ballots sent 83,008 (state 82,173). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-27 21:44): early in person 52,916 (state 51,245). Hancock: mail returned 2,470 (state 2,314); early in person 7,572 (state 7,175). Henry (as of 2026-10-27 16:58): early in person 2,725 (state 2,525). Morrow (as of 2026-10-28 18:55): mail returned 1,157 (state 1,111); early in person 2,794 (state 2,567).
